text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Mm. Is my skin breaking out?
This... cannot be overlooked."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, I think it'll be totally fine, but... wow, Yaeno-chan can be like an ordinary girl sometimes too, huh."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To always keep one's appearance neat and presentable is also one of the secret teachings handed down through the Yaegaki style.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Showing an unsightly face to the strong one who defeated me
would be utterly disrespectful.
Hmm... what ought I to do?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Th-That reason's a lot more ominous than I thought...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In any case, Yaeno Muteki was
gravely troubled by her rough skin.
